title: rain on the kamo river
description:
The forecast said clear and the sky said otherwise, so I spent the whole day under shop awnings along the Kamo, watching the rain take the blossom down a week early. There is a specific quiet grief to petals on wet tarmac that nobody warns you about.

I used to think the point of chasing the cherry front was catching it. Standing there with a soaked camera and two dry frames left, it occurred to me that the season is mostly about missing it — the trees are only briefly the thing you came for, and the rest is weather, and waiting, and herons who have seen all of it before.

Shot almost nothing. Remember almost everything.
